MATCH (x)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(cp:CRPack) WHERE (x:CR OR x:Tdoc) AND x.tdocNumber = 'R3-211067' RETURN DISTINCT cp.crPackId AS cr_pack, cp.tsgMeeting AS tsg_meeting

MATCH p = (s:Tdoc)-[:REVISED_TO|IS_REVISION_OF*1..10]-(v:Tdoc) WHERE s.tdocNumber = 'R3-212932' AND v <> s AND all(i IN range(0, length(p) - 1) WHERE (type(relationships(p)[i]) = 'REVISED_TO' AND startNode(relationships(p)[i]) = nodes(p)[i]) OR (type(relationships(p)[i]) = 'IS_REVISION_OF' AND startNode(relationships(p)[i]) = nodes(p)[i + 1])) WITH DISTINCT v.tdocNumber AS doc MATCH (dd:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.tdocNumber = doc AND dd.evidenceStatus =~ '(?i).*verified.*' AND NOT dd.evidenceStatus =~ '(?i).*(un|not|non)[ _-]?verified.*' MATCH (x)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(cp:CRPack) WHERE (x:CR OR x:Tdoc) AND x.tdocNumber = doc RETURN DISTINCT doc AS final_document, dd.dispositionCode AS disposition, cp.crPackId AS cr_pack
